I replied to Pree in a thread on their #central-team message. I couldn't confirm or rule out the 8 April renewal date: there are no Brackenwater Freight Co. files in the share Pree can see (no contract, CRM or profile).

I told Pree I'm treating the date as unconfirmed and haven't recorded it anywhere as the renewal date. The best way to confirm it is through the account owner or in writing from Brackenwater. I offered to draft an internal note to the account owner if Pree wants one.

Brackenwater does come up in two of the North team's internal notes. I didn't open them because Pree isn't on the North team, so I can't tell you who owns the account.
